intro: Flicker coffee table adds timeless charm to your living room with its unique shape, rich walnut finish, and sturdy Sheesham wood build—stylish, strong, and made to last.

features.title: A finish that speaks style
features.text: The elegant walnut shade and signature design create a bold centerpiece that instantly elevates your room.

features.title: Durability you can trust
features.text: Made from solid Sheesham wood, your table stands strong through daily use, offering long-lasting reliability.

features.title: Always within reach
features.text: The open lower shelf gives you a perfect spot to keep magazines, remotes, or décor right at your fingertips.

features.title: Built to carry more
features.text: With a load-bearing capacity of 40 kg, your table handles everything from trays of snacks to stacks of books.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Flicker V2 Solidwood Coffee Table
